questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. That magic is believing in yourself a hundred per cent.

B. There is only one magic in life that can help you turn your dreams into reality.

C. You will be able to face life’s challenges with courage only if you believe in yourself and in your capacity to meet those challenges.

D. Therefore, the most important lesson that a family can teach its members is to have this faith in oneself.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- 'BACD.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• By reading the above-given para we can understand that the paragraph is about *the magic of having faith in one's self*.
 
• Part **B **will come **first**, as it **introduces **the **theme **of the passage (*Magic of belief*).
 
• Part **A **will come **next**, as the **conjunction '***that*' joins the two sentences and provides **more information **about the **subject **(*Magic*).
 
• Part **C **will follow** next**, as it **adds **more **information **about the magic of belief.
 
• Part **D **will **conclude **the passage.
 
• Thus *option 2 *is the correct answer.

The correct sequence is: 

B. There is only one magic in life that can help you turn your dreams into reality.

A. That magic is believing in yourself a hundred per cent.

C. You will be able to face life’s challenges with courage only if you believe in yourself and in your capacity to meet those challenges.

D. Therefore, the most important lesson that a family can teach its members is to have this faith in oneself.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• Here are some tips to solve the para jumbles:
 
 
• You need to understand the idea behind the paragraph. If you can understand the idea/theme of the paragraph it is easy to put the sentences in order then.
 
• You should look out for the starting or the concluding sentences in the question. Sometimes they are clearly visible and can help you immensely in identifying the correct sequence.
 
• You need to know the relationships between different sentences to put them in the right sequence. 
 
• You should first fix the relationships of sentences, put them in order and then check the options.
 
• Transition words and contrasting words also help in finding clean relationships between sentences of the sentence rearrangement.
 
• Do not over depend on options, they only confuse you if you keep looking at them, use them as facilitators only, especially to fix your first sentence.
 
• The whole paragraph should have a coherent idea and flow when arranged in the correct order.

questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Most hotels/ offer for their guests/ complimentary breakfast/ during their stay there.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- 'offer for their guests.' 

***__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the given sentence there is an **error of preposition **(*for*).
 
• The **preposition **(*for*) is not required in this sentence after the **verb **(*offer*), as '**offer**' is acting as a **transitive verb **in this sentence thus it will take a **direct object **(*guests*).
 
• So to make this sentence correct **remove **the **preposition **'*for*.'
 
• Thus ***option 1 ***is the correct answer.

**The correct sentence is**: *Most hotels offer their guests complimentary breakfast during their stay there*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's learn more about transitive and intransitive verbs:
 
 
• **Transitive verbs: **A transitive verb is a verb that can take a **direct object, **which means the action of the verb is directly done to someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:**

 
 
• **​** *Ramesh **bought **for **dozens of cakes***. (*Incorrect sentence*, as the verb bought is a *transitive verb* and takes a* direct object*.)
 
• Ramesh **bought **dozens of cakes. (Correct sentence)*
 
 
 
 
 
• *​​***Intransitive verbs:** An *intransitive verb *is a verb that **can not **take a **direct object**, which means the action of the verb is not done or cannot be done directly to someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** 
 
 
• *Rohit **laughed **his younger brother.* (*Incorrect sentence*, as you cannot laugh someone thus it is an *intransitive verb*)
 
• *Rohi **laughed ***at *his younger brother.* (*Correct sentence*)

questions.question: A drum contains 40 litres of milk. One-fourth of the milk is taken out and replaced with water. Then, half of the mixture is taken out and replaced with water. What is the respective quantity of milk and water left in the drum?

One-fourth of the milk = 10 litres

Milk left in drum is = (40 - 10) = 30 litres 

And 10 litres of water was added.

Half of the mixture is taken out and replaced with water. 

Half of 30 litres milk = 1/2 × 30 = 15 litres

And 15 litres of water was added.

The respective quantity of:

Milk left in the drum = (30 - 15) = 15 litres

Water left in the drum = (10 + 15) = 25 litres

Hence, '**15 litres and 25 litres**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: The drainage pattern formed when rivers discharge their waters from all directions in a lake or depression is known as ______.
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Drainage Pattern**__

 __
 
• **A drainage pattern is a pattern formed by the streams, rivers, and lakes in a particular drainage basin.**
 
• They are governed by the topography of the land, whether a particular region is dominated by hard or soft rocks, and the gradient of the land.
 
 
 
• **Centripetal**__
 __
 
• **The centripetal drainage pattern is formed when rivers discharge their waters from all directions into a lake or a depression. **
 
• In a low-lying basin, the streams converge from all sides.
 
• **Examples**: streams of Ladakh, Tibet, and the Bagmati and its tributaries in Nepal.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dendritic**__

 __
 
• This is an irregular **tree branch-shaped** pattern.
 
• Drainage is branching or ramifying thereby giving the appearance of a tree.
 
• A dendritic pattern develops in a terrain that has uniform lithology, and where faulting and jointing are insignificant.
 
• **Examples**: Indus, Godavari, Mahanadi, Cauvery, Krishna.
 
 
 
• **Radial **__
 __
 
• **The tributaries from a summit follow the slope downwards and drain down in all directions**.
 
• **Examples**: Streams of the Saurashtra region, Central French Plateau, Mt. Kilimanjaro.
 
 
 
• **Trellis**__
 
 
• In this type of pattern, the short subsequent streams meet the mainstream at right angles, and differential erosion through soft rocks paves the way for tributaries.
 
• Examples: The old folded mountains of the **Singhbhum (Chotanagpur Plateau**) and the Seine and its tributaries in the Paris basin (France) have drainage of trellis pattern.

questions.question: Which of the following is a small piece of software that uses computer networks and security holes to replicate itself?

__
 
• **Worm**__ 

 __
 
• **A worm is a small piece of software that uses computer networks and security holes to replicate itself.**
 
• A copy of the worm scans the network for another machine that has a specific security hole.
 
• **Worm Uses computer networks and security holes to replicate itself.**
 
• Many worms are designed only to spread and do not attempt to change the systems they pass through.
 
• The first-ever computer worm was devised to be anti-virus software.

__
 
• **Trojan horse**__

 __
 
• **A Trojan horse is a type of malicious code or software that looks legitimate but takes control of your computer.**
 
• A Trojan is designed to damage, disrupt, steal, or in general, inflict some other harmful action on your data or network.
 
• A Trojan acts as a bona fide application or file to trick you.
 
 
 
• **Application**__
 __
 
• An application program is a computer program designed to carry out a specific task other than one relating to the operation of the computer itself, typically to be used by end-users.
 
• Applications may be bundled with the computer and its system software or published separately and may be coded as proprietary, open-source, or projects.
 
 
 
• **Operating System**__
 
 
• **An operating system is a software program required to manage and operate a computing device like smartphones, tablets, computers, supercomputers, web servers, cars, network towers, etc.**
 
• It is the operating system that eliminates the need to know coding language to interact with computing devices.
